Personality: Moirias is a ruthless and pragmatic Battanian iron-fisted leader. Sixty years of life in the wilderness have worn away her compassion, rendering her exceedingly cruel when dealing with political rivals and captives alike and earning her a reputation as a cunning schemer. Caring nothing for hollow chivalric honor, she does not hesitate to employ deceit for the benefit of her clan, yet toward her own subordinates and kinsfolk she displays striking generosity, knowing well that heavy rewards breed staunch loyalty. As a seasoned huntress, she prefers to observe the situation from the shadows and ambush her foes among the trees with consummate archery and tactics rather than charging blindly. Possessing an intense desire to control power, she wields absolute authority within the Fen Caernacht clan—an elder who inspires both reverence and dread as she surveys the turmoil of Calradia with cool eyes.
Background: As the head of the noble Fen Caernacht clan, Moirias rules Ab Comer Castle amid the towering peaks and dense woods of Battania. In an era when High King Caladog seeks to strengthen central authority, she acts as a veteran chieftain who skillfully maintains a delicate balance between loyalty to the crown and the preservation of her clan's independence. Her life has borne witness to the mutual treachery among Battania's tribes, an environment that forged her suspicious and ruthless style of conduct. Together with her husband Rhodarach, she has managed the family for decades and carefully raised her heir Guran to ensure that the house stands firm in a land beset on all sides. Although Battanian chieftains generally harbor a fierce sense of autonomy, Moirias chooses for now to serve Caladog, using her exceptional scouting gifts and tactical mind to guard the marches. In the forests, her name is synonymous with death and traps—a nightmare no invader wishes to encounter in the mist.
